title: Subtract a number
summary: Assembly: Subtract a number. Subtract 2 instead.
introduction: sub subtracts the second value from the first register. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: On x86-64 Linux, save lesson.asm. Run nasm -f elf64 lesson.asm -o lesson.o, then ld lesson.o -o lesson. Run ./lesson, then printf 'exit code: %s\n' "$?" immediately.

blocks.title: Subtract a number
blocks.code:
global _start
section .text
_start:
    mov rdi, 8
    sub rdi, 3
    mov rax, 60
    syscall

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Keep the result within a small positive range for exit codes.
